gaps.title: Absence of Hard Multi-Tenant Schema Partitioning / Row-Level Security (RLS)
gaps.current_state: Single-tenant architecture where teams exist in a shared PostgreSQL schema. All rows are filtered in code via `teamId` and `projectId` queries. No database-level RLS policies or isolated tenant schemas exist.
gaps.target_state: Enforce PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies tied to the authenticated tenant session or optional schema-per-tenant isolation for multi-tenant SaaS hosting.
gaps.business_risk: Potential data leak across teams if application-layer SQL filters miss a tenant predicate in complex joins or custom queries.
gaps.remediation_strategy: Implement Drizzle RLS helper policies setting `app.current_team_id` session variable on each transaction and enforce DB-level constraints.

gaps.title: Incomplete Enterprise SAML 2.0 / OIDC IdP Single Sign-On
gaps.current_state: Authentication supports Google OAuth, username/password, and WebAuthn Passkeys via better-auth, with SCIM 2.0 user provisioning. Direct SAML 2.0 / OIDC enterprise connectors (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingIdentity) are not plugged into the auth configuration.
gaps.target_state: Turnkey Enterprise SSO supporting SAML 2.0 SP/IdP-initiated flows, automatic JIT account provisioning, and IdP group-to-RBAC role mapping.
gaps.business_risk: Blocks procurement and adoption by Fortune 500 and heavily regulated enterprise customers mandating centralized SAML SSO.
gaps.remediation_strategy: Integrate `@better-auth/sso` or custom Passport/SAML adapter in `packages/auth` and expose SAML metadata upload in instance settings.

gaps.title: Manual Rollback Protocol & Missing Down-Migration Mechanics
gaps.current_state: The API dumps the PostgreSQL database to a volume prior to running migrations on startup (`migrate.ts`). However, if an upgrade introduces runtime regression after migration, rollback requires manual operator intervention (pg_restore + container image downgrade). No automated down-migrations exist in Drizzle.
gaps.target_state: Automated canary healthcheck with automated rollback triggering, paired with bidirectional Drizzle migration scripts (`down.sql`) and verified snapshot restore drills.
gaps.business_risk: Extended MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) during enterprise version upgrades if database migration regressions occur.
gaps.remediation_strategy: Generate reversible SQL migrations, integrate health-check-based automatic rollbacks into Coolify/Helm deployments, and add pre-flight validation.

gaps.title: Mutable Activity Logs & Lack of Immutable Cryptographic Audit Retention
gaps.current_state: Issue changes and webhook dispatches are logged to `issue_activity` and `webhook_delivery`, but rows are mutable by DB superusers, lack cryptographic tamper-evidence (SHA-256 chaining), and lack configurable cold-storage archival (e.g. S3 WORM / Glacier 7-year retention).
gaps.target_state: Tamper-evident append-only audit ledger with cryptographic event chaining, automated export to immutable S3 storage, and configurable retention compliance policies.
gaps.business_risk: Failure to satisfy SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA compliance requirements regarding immutable audit trails.
gaps.remediation_strategy: Build an append-only audit log module in `packages/db` with SHA-256 signature chains and a background worker job exporting archived audit chunks to S3.

gaps.title: Internal Agent Tool Execution in Shared Process Memory
gaps.current_state: While @itsaplan/runner executes external agents in the user's host environment with CLI sandboxing, internal Mastra agents execute tool calls directly inside the `apps/api` or `apps/worker` Node/Bun process context.
gaps.target_state: Isolated ephemeral sandbox containers (e.g. Docker-in-Docker, gVisor, or WASM microVM) for internal agent tool execution, with CPU/memory cgroups and strict SSRF egress filters.
gaps.business_risk: Malicious or hallucinatory agent scripts/skills executing untrusted code could exhaust host resources or attempt local port scans.
gaps.remediation_strategy: Enforce strict `@repo/net` egress validation on all HTTP tool calls and delegate arbitrary code execution to disposable sandbox containers.
